Re: Safety Concerns at the Basketball Courts at Knapp Ranch Park
1 message

Rap Commissioners <rap.commissioners@lacity.org>  Mon, Aug 17, 2026 at 10:07 AM
To: Arash Nikooei <  >
Cc: RAP PublicInfo <RAP.PublicInfo@lacity.org>, Councilmember Lee <councilmember.lee@lacity.org>, Myrka Martinez
<myrka.martinez@lacity.org>,  ,  ,
  ,  ,  ,  ,
  ,  ,  ,  ,

 Good morning,
 Thank you for contacting the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners Office, your email will be forwarded to the
 Commissioners.

 On Mon, Aug 17, 2026 at 9:03 AM Arash Nikooei <  > wrote:
  Dear Parks and Recreation Department,

  I am writing on behalf of many residents and regular users of the basketball courts at Knapp Ranch Park, many of
  whom are copied on this email.

  The courts have not received any major improvements in over 20 years and have become a serious safety concern.
  The playing surface is covered with cracks, the basketball poles are heavily rusted, the dried paint and the deteriorated
  asphalt has resulted in numerous injuries.

  In the past two years alone, there have been at least five serious injuries after players lost their footing on the uneven
  court surface, including ankle and Achilles injuries. Several of these injuries required surgery, resulting in lengthy
  recoveries for those affected. We are concerned that, without repairs, it is only a matter of time before someone suffers
  an even more serious injury.

  These courts are used every day by children, teenagers, and adults and are an important part of our community. Many
  of us grew up playing here and hope they can be restored for future generations.

  Attached are photographs showing the current condition of the courts, as well as post-surgery photos shar
summary: Report on public communications received by the Recreation and Parks Board regarding various parks and facilities, including safety concerns at basketball courts, staff at recreation centers, and park issues.
